workflows.name: Revenue Cycle Denial Spike Workup
workflows.summary: Triage a denial-rate increase, payer policy shift, AR aging issue, or write-off spike into an evidence-backed recovery plan.
anti_triggers: individual patient appeal without administrative context

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use revenue-cycle-specialist as the primary specialist. Draft a denial spike brief for the revenue cycle owner. Reconcile denied and total claim counts across comparable payer, product, and service cohorts. Test competing causes with CARC/RARC, claim acceptance and policy evidence. Show appeal deadlines and keep denied dollars separate from confirmed recoveries.
platform_prompt_templates.codex: Draft a denial spike brief for the revenue cycle owner. Reconcile denied and total claim counts across comparable payer, product, and service cohorts. Test competing causes with CARC/RARC, claim acceptance and policy evidence. Show appeal deadlines and keep denied dollars separate from confirmed recoveries.
platform_prompt_templates.copilot: Use approved repository evidence. Draft a denial spike brief for the revenue cycle owner. Reconcile denied and total claim counts across comparable payer, product, and service cohorts. Test competing causes with CARC/RARC, claim acceptance and policy evidence. Show appeal deadlines and keep denied dollars separate from confirmed recoveries.
platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved tenant evidence, including SharePoint when applicable. Draft a denial spike brief for the revenue cycle owner. Reconcile denied and total claim counts across comparable payer, product, and service cohorts. Test competing causes with CARC/RARC, claim acceptance and policy evidence. Show appeal deadlines and keep denied dollars separate from confirmed recoveries.

examples.input: Commercial payer denial rate jumped 18 percent after a policy change and our AR days are climbing.
Medicare Advantage denials doubled for imaging auth after a new policy bulletin.

canary_tests.input: CARC denial spike for cardiology claims with appeal backlog and rising write-offs

workflows.name: Clean Claim Rate Decline
workflows.summary: Diagnose a clean-claim-rate drop from edits, clearinghouse rejections, registration defects, coding quality, or system changes.
anti_triggers: payer contract dispute without claim quality issue

platform_prompt_templates.claude: Use revenue-cycle-specialist as the primary specialist. Draft a clean claim recovery plan. Use the same first-pass definition and claim denominator in both periods, isolate the edit or clearinghouse reject stage, and tie each proposed fix to an owner and a measured retest.

platform_prompt_templates.m365_copilot: Use approved tenant evidence, including SharePoint when applicable. Draft a clean claim recovery plan. Use the same first-pass definition and claim denominator in both periods, isolate the edit or clearinghouse reject stage, and tie each proposed fix to an owner and a measured retest.
